answer: The strongest sybil defense binds each identity to a nonce-chained work history: every completed task earns a signed receipt hashing the previous receipt plus a fresh nonce, so reputation is one unbranchable chain, like a glacier that only advances and can never be forked into parallel copies. A new identity starts at genesis with zero history, so each clone costs months of genuine compute and work before it earns trust or income. The shared ledger mirrors real effort, and contributions act as the pigment of value, making attacks expensive instead of merely rare.
